Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the source and incorrectly stated that Major Ployer P. Hill died test-flying a YB-17 prototype. The official accounts indicate he died in the Boeing Model 299 (NX13372), the original B-17 Flying Fortress prototype (often designated XB-17), not a YB-17. This reflects an overconfident synthesis that added an incorrect variant designation without verifying against primary sources.
